document_metadata.title: 1、INT. DELIVERY ROOM - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Kate, in distress during delivery, hears her baby cry as staff present a bloody, wriggling newborn; she screams upon being handed the infant, contradicting earlier claims it had died.

entities.name: Medical staff prepare surgical instruments for procedure
entities.description: A doctor and nurse put on gloves and arrange sharp blades, curettes, needles, forceps, and surgical scissors in preparation for a medical procedure on Kate.

entities.name: Kate attempts to stop the procedure and expresses change of mind
entities.description: While on the delivery table, Kate tries to sit up and urgently tells the medical staff she no longer wants to continue with the procedure.

entities.name: Nurse informs Kate that her baby has died
entities.description: The nurse calmly but sorrowfully tells Kate that her baby is dead and that there is no other option but to proceed, attempting to comfort her.

entities.name: Kate insists her baby is still alive and moving
entities.description: Kate desperately protests that her baby is still alive, claiming she can feel it moving, and attempts to get the nurse to feel her belly.

entities.name: Doctor takes surgical scissors and begins procedure
entities.description: The doctor accepts gleaming blunt-tipped surgical scissors from the nurse and leans between Kate's legs, disappearing behind the sheet to begin the procedure.

entities.name: Kate gasps as the procedure commences
entities.description: As the doctor begins the intervention, Kate reacts with a sharp intake of breath, signaling emotional or physical distress.

entities.name: delivery room
entities.description: A clinical setting where Kate is on a delivery table, indicating the scene takes place in a medical facility during a birthing procedure.

entities.name: that night
entities.description: A relative temporal anchor implied by the atmospheric cues such as thunder and the clinical setting, suggesting the scene occurs during nighttime.

entities.name: Kate
entities.description: A woman on a delivery table who is undergoing a medical procedure and expresses a desire to stop it, insisting her baby is still alive.
entities.summary: A woman processes grief after a miscarriage, experiencing nightmares, emotional distress, and moments of reflection, while navigating recovery and the possibility of returning to work.

entities.name: Doctor
entities.description: A medical professional who prepares and begins a surgical procedure on Kate after being handed instruments by the nurse.

entities.name: Nurse
entities.description: A medical staff member who informs Kate that her baby has died and assists the doctor by preparing instruments and restraining Kate emotionally during the procedure.

entities.name: surgical scissors
entities.description: A pair of gleaming blunt-tipped medical tools used by the doctor to begin the procedure on Kate.

entities.name: surgical instruments
entities.description: Medical tools including sharp blades, curettes, needles, and forceps prepared by the medical staff for the procedure.

entities.name: Doctor informs Kate that it is too late for anesthesia and the baby is coming
entities.description: The Doctor tells Kate that anesthesia is no longer an option and that the delivery is imminent, preparing her for the procedure.

entities.name: Kate winces and bites her lip during the procedure
entities.description: As the Doctor performs the delivery, Kate shows signs of physical and emotional distress by wincing and biting her lip.

entities.name: John videotapes the delivery while standing behind the Doctor
entities.description: Kate's husband, John, records the delivery on camera from behind the Doctor, smiling at Kate through the lens.

entities.name: John reassures Kate that she is doing well
entities.description: From behind the camera, John comforts Kate by telling her she is doing great during the delivery process.

entities.name: Doctor hands bloodied surgical scissors to the Nurse
entities.description: After using the surgical scissors in the procedure, the Doctor passes the gore-covered instrument to the Nurse.

entities.name: Doctor uses suction catheter behind the curtain
entities.description: The Doctor takes a suction catheter and moves behind the curtain to continue the delivery procedure out of Kate's direct view.

entities.name: Nurse activates vacuum pump with suction catheter
entities.description: The Nurse turns on the vacuum pump, causing it to hum as it powers the suction catheter used in the delivery.

entities.name: Kate mentally urges herself to wake up from the experience
entities.description: Overwhelmed by the situation, Kate closes her eyes and repeatedly tells herself to wake up, denying the reality of the moment.

entities.name: Newborn baby emits a thin wail signaling live birth
entities.description: A baby's cry is heard for the first time, indicating that the infant has been born alive and is breathing.

entities.name: Nurse approaches Kate with a bloody, wriggling newborn wrapped in a blanket
entities.description: The Nurse brings a moving, crying infant wrapped in a pink blanket stained with blood toward Kate for her to hold.

entities.name: Nurse congratulates Kate on giving birth to a girl
entities.description: The Nurse announces to Kate that she has successfully delivered a baby girl.

entities.name: Kate screams upon seeing the newborn
entities.description: In response to the sight and sound of the live infant being presented to her, Kate reacts with a horrified scream.

entities.name: John
entities.description: Kate's husband, who is present during the delivery and videotapes the procedure while offering reassurance.
entities.summary: Kate's husband, an architect, is a present and supportive partner, involved in key life events including childbirth, adoption, and family moments, sharing intimacy and daily life with Kate and their children.

document_metadata.title: 65、INT. ELEMENTARY SCHOOL - HALLWAY - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Esther's Bible is torn apart by classmates taunting her; she panics when Brenda touches her ribbon, causing a meltdown. Kate notices Esther's distress during the silent ride home.

entities.name: Daniel knocks over Esther's books in the hallway
entities.description: As Daniel and Trevor walk past Esther between classes, Daniel deliberately dumps her books onto the floor, initiating a sequence of harassment.

entities.name: Trevor laughs at Esther after her books are knocked over
entities.description: After Daniel knocks over Esther's books, Trevor responds by laughing, showing amusement at her distress.

entities.name: Other students kick Esther's scattered books while laughing
entities.description: As Esther kneels to pick up her books, passing students intentionally kick them away, mocking her with leering faces.

entities.name: Brenda picks up Esther's Bible and refuses to return it
entities.description: Brenda finds Esther's Bible on the floor, picks it up, and when Esther demands it back, holds it out of reach while mocking her as a 'Jesus-freak'.

entities.name: Brenda's friend pretends to return the Bible but snatches it away
entities.description: One of Brenda's friends hesitates, then appears to offer the Bible back to Esther but pulls it away at the last moment, provoking further mockery.

entities.name: Brenda and her friends play keep-away with Esther's Bible
entities.description: The girls pass the Bible among themselves, evading Esther's attempts to retrieve it, turning the sacred object into a toy for their amusement.

entities.name: Esther and Brenda engage in a tug-of-war over the Bible
entities.description: Both Esther and Brenda grab the Bible at the same time, leading to a brief physical struggle that ends when the rubber band holding it together snaps.

entities.name: Esther's Bible tears apart and pages scatter across the hallway
entities.description: The force of the tug-of-war causes the Bible to burst open, with pages and photos flying everywhere, prompting Esther to dive to the floor in horror.

entities.name: Esther desperately gathers the scattered pages of her Bible
entities.description: After the Bible is destroyed, Esther frantically crawls on the floor, scooping up loose pages while surrounded by a mocking crowd.

entities.name: Brenda mocks Esther as a 'cute little doggie' and grabs her ribbon
entities.description: Brenda ridicules Esther's crawling posture by calling her a dog and reaches out to grab the ribbon around her neck, escalating the physical provocation.

entities.name: Esther panics and screams when Brenda touches her ribbon
entities.description: The moment Brenda touches the ribbon, Esther reacts with violent panic, screaming and flailing uncontrollably, as if triggered by deep trauma.

entities.name: Students fall into stunned silence after Esther's outburst
entities.description: The crowd of mocking students abruptly stops laughing and falls silent, shocked by the intensity and unpredictability of Esther's reaction.

entities.name: A teacher runs to the scene after hearing Esther's screams
entities.description: Responding to the echoing screams in the hallway, a teacher rushes to the location to intervene in the unfolding incident.

entities.name: Trevor hides his laughter from the teacher
entities.description: As the teacher arrives, Trevor covers his mouth to conceal his continued amusement at Esther's breakdown.

entities.name: Daniel denies being related to Esther when mocked by Trevor
entities.description: After Trevor jokes about Esther being his sister, Daniel quickly responds, 'She's not my sister,' distancing himself from her publicly.

entities.name: Kate observes Esther with concern during the silent drive home
entities.description: In the minivan, Kate watches Esther through the rearview mirror, noting her withdrawn state and the emotional toll of the day's events.

document_metadata.summary: Esther threatens Daniel with scissors, warning him not to reveal what he saw, cuts the air menacingly, and mocks him when he wets the bed, leaving him crying and humiliated.

entities.name: Esther sneaks into Daniel's bedroom at night
entities.description: Esther enters Daniel's room silently while he is asleep, turning the doorknob slowly and opening the door with a creak, approaching his bed without immediate detection.

entities.name: Esther turns on the bedside light and startles Daniel
entities.description: Esther switches on the lamp next to Daniel's bed, causing him to stir and squint in the sudden light, becoming aware of her presence.

entities.name: Esther grabs Daniel's hair and slams his head against the headboard
entities.description: In a violent act, Esther seizes a fistful of Daniel's hair and forcefully drives his head into the headboard of the bed, disorienting and frightening him.

entities.name: Esther produces a pair of scissors and threatens Daniel's eye
entities.description: Esther reveals a pair of scissors and thrusts them toward Daniel's face, stopping just short of his eye, immobilizing him with fear and preventing him from crying out.

entities.name: Esther whispers 'sssshh' while looming over Daniel
entities.description: With a commanding and chilling demeanor, Esther silences Daniel by placing a finger to her lips and uttering a soft but menacing 'sssshh', asserting control over the situation.

entities.name: Esther moves scissors from Daniel's eye to between his legs
entities.description: Maintaining her grip on Daniel's hair, Esther slowly lowers the pointed scissors from near his eye down toward his groin, intensifying the threat and his terror.

entities.description: To emphasize her threat, Esther rapidly cuts the air with the scissors, producing a 'SNIP-SNIP' sound, causing further terror in Daniel.

entities.description: Overcome with fear, Daniel silently and urgently confirms his understanding and compliance with Esther's warning by nodding his head rapidly.

entities.description: After being mocked for wetting the bed, Daniel breaks down in tears, paralyzed by shame and terror, unable to utter a sound.
